name: Describe Video
description: Analyze and describe a video by sampling frames and using a vision-capable LLM.

function.name: describe_video
function.description: Analyze a video file by sampling frames across its duration (packed into labelled 2x2 grids) and describing them with a vision-capable LLM. Visual track only; audio is not transcribed.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to a video visible in the agent's local filesystem, sandbox, scratchpad, or workplace (.mp4, .mov, .webm, .mkv, .3gp, .avi). Max 100 MB.

query.description: Optional specific question about the video. Write your question in English. If omitted, returns a general description of the video.

mock_response: {"description": "This is a sample video description from the mock response."}
